patch_description:
Replace the clipped ring construction with a deterministic nonlinear optimization of all circle centers and radii.  The previous outer ring placed many centers nearly on the boundary and then clipped them together, leaving very small radii.  The new constructor starts from feasible staggered hexagonal/layered arrangements, then uses SLSQP to maximize the radius sum subject directly to every boundary and pairwise non-overlap constraint.

Two complementary layered initial layouts are used because boundary effects make a perfectly symmetric lattice unnecessarily restrictive.  The best result is selected.  A final global feasibility scaling removes numerical constraint tolerances, ensuring all reported circles are strictly inside the square and pairwise non-overlapping even if the optimizer terminates slightly outside a constraint tolerance.  The public interface and return values are unchanged.
